title: SR-1.37 Select discovered clients and complete connection
request: The owner requested selectable discovery, connection, lead selection and logged acceptance. Repository: memev-app; baseline 589d61ca1ce6853f0bb9a7a520fc45ff20450e54. Programme placement: contracts/programme/specs in memev, with repo memev-app in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Spec workdir remains null as required by the gate. The memev-app checkout goes through the verify CLI workdir argument only: memev contract new <this spec> --workdir <memev-app checkout> --base 589d61ca1ce6853f0bb9a7a520fc45ff20450e54, then memev verify <id> (or memev gate --workdir <memev-app checkout>). Verify runs every command criterion with that workdir as its working directory: red in a temporary worktree of the recorded base holding the head's test files, green in the workdir itself. No command criterion changes directory or names the app checkout, so red and green measure different code. Baseline ancestry (the app HEAD descends from 589d61ca1ce6853f0bb9a7a520fc45ff20450e54) is checked once by the separate precondition criterion T1-c02, not inside behavioral tests. MEMEV_VAULT_WORKDIR names the memev vault checkout; only T4-c03, which checks vault scope, needs it, and it must be set in the environment of the process that runs the criteria. Scope must check both repositories; the vault scope must include contracts/programme/manifest.json and must not silently skip contracts/. Depends on SR-1.36 verified and landed. Only the owner signs. No implementation before signature. The guide's decisions (which apps are listed and ticked, which are connected, step order, the lead step and its retry, fix text and which fixes are safe) live in Memev.Reader (net9.0, no window), and the WPF screens in Memev.Desktop only show them; so every behavioural criterion runs headless through Memev.Reader.Check with a fixture core, on macOS, Linux or Windows, and needs the .NET 9 SDK and node 22 on the verifying computer; each such criterion has timeout_s 1200, because the red run makes a cold build of the base in a fresh worktree. Build output stays under native/windows (its tracked .gitignore holds bin/ and obj/). The WPF window cases in native/windows/test/self-check.ps1 stay a memev-app CI check on windows-latest; no verify criterion runs pwsh. Each task's red-green tests name every case they cover as an exact named subtest; red-green behavioral tests require measured failing-base and passing-head results; precondition and regression-only checks are labelled separately and are not red-green proof.

tasks.title: The guide lists every app found and connects the ones ticked
requirements: the guide's decisions for T1 to T3 are made by a class in native/windows/Memev.Reader (for example a new GuideModel.cs), which reads the core's JSON output and returns what to show and what to run; Memev.Desktop calls it and renders the result. Memev.Reader.Check gains a --case <name> option that runs only that case against a fixture core (a .cmd file on Windows, a shell script elsewhere, as its Program.cs does today) answering discover --json, connect --json, doctor --json, doctor --fix --safe-only, start and the bus roster, and prints 'ok <name>' only after that case's assertions pass; an unknown case exits non-zero

the Connect step reads memev discover --json and shows every found app; apps with automation auto are ticked by default, one-step apps show their step and a Copy button, apps with none show found and not connectable
the primary button reads Connect N apps and connects exactly the ticked apps after one sheet that names the files changed and their backups; the result list shows each app's outcome and seat
Rows with automation none are unticked and disabled; their ids never appear in the connect invocation. One-step rows also have no tick and are excluded.

This task's red-green test T1-c01 covers every T1 case, each an exact named subtest: "T1-c01: connect-list": the five fixture rows are displayed; only three auto rows are ticked, and the none row is disabled and unticked; "T1-c01: connect-onestep": the one-step row shows its step and a Copy button and has no tick; "T1-c01: connect-selected": unticking one auto row connects exactly the remaining two auto ids; none and one-step ids are excluded; "T1-c01: connect-result": the result list shows each app's status and seat from connect --json. T4-c02 re-runs the same cases as an aggregate check; it does not replace this task's own test.

This task owns named test T1-c01 in test/guide-cases.test.mjs; each of its four subtests must actually invoke dotnet run --project native/windows/Memev.Reader.Check -c Release -- --case <case> for its own case, assert exit 0 and the line 'ok <case>', which Memev.Reader.Check prints only after that case's own assertions ran, fail on the recorded baseline and pass at head.
